plain: Supplemental Security Income. A monthly payment from Social Security for people with disabilities, or aged 65 or older, who have little income and savings.
technical: Title XVI of the Social Security Act. 2026 federal benefit rate: $994 individual.

plain: Health coverage. In most states, people who receive SSI also get Medicaid.
technical: Eligibility often follows SSI; some states (209(b)) use their own rules.

plain: The part of her income that Social Security subtracts from the check, after small exclusions.
technical: Unearned income after the infrequent or irregular exclusion and the $20 general exclusion, plus countable earned income.

plain: Money and things of value that count toward the $2,000 limit. Her home, one car and personal belongings usually do not count.
technical: Resources, measured at the first moment of each month. POMS SI 01110.003.

plain: Help with housing that someone else pays for, such as rent or utilities. It lowers the check by up to $351.33 a month in 2026.
technical: Shelter only since September 30, 2024 (89 FR 21199). Valued with the presumed maximum value or the one-third reduction.

plain: The most that housing help can lower the check in a month: $351.33 in 2026 for one person.
technical: One third of the federal benefit rate plus $20. POMS SI 00835.901.

plain: A fixed reduction of $331.33 when she lives in someone else's home all month and does not pay her share of housing.
technical: POMS SI 00835.200. The $20 general exclusion does not apply to it.

plain: A tax-advantaged savings account for people whose disability began before age 46. The first $100,000 does not count toward the savings limit.
technical: Section 529A accounts. POMS SI 01130.740. 2026 contribution limit $20,000 from all sources.

plain: When someone pays a shop or service directly for her, instead of giving her the money.
technical: Third-party vendor payment. Not income unless it provides shelter. 20 CFR 416.1103(g).

plain: Income counted in one month changes the check two months later.
A person or organization that manages SSI payments for someone who needs help with money.
technical: Appointed by Social Security; reports changes and keeps records.

plain: A practice version of PayPal where no real money moves. Every payment in this demo uses it.
technical: api-m.sandbox.paypal.com with sandbox business and personal accounts.

plain: A message PayPal sends to Giftwise when a payment finishes, so the receipt appears automatically.
A private code that lets another app use Giftwise.
technical: Bearer token gw_test_..., stored only as a SHA-256 hash.

plain: A standard way for AI assistants to use tools. Other assistants can ask Giftwise before buying a gift.
technical: Model Context Protocol. Giftwise serves Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp.
